# Shared links expire after a chosen time

## 1. Problem

A shared link stays open for ever. People share a note for a review or a customer call and forget the link. We want the
person who shares a note to choose how long the link works.

## 2. What we want

- When someone shares a note, they can pick a time after which the link stops working, such as 1 day, 7 days or 30 days.
- A link with no chosen time keeps working as it does today.
- Someone who opens an expired link sees that it has expired, not the note.

## 3. Not now

- Changing the time on a link that already exists.
- Anything about the note's own lifetime.
